articles.summary: We gave 13 AI models screenshots of animated components from 21st and asked for the code. GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra rebuilt nearly all of them, and shaders split the rest.
articles.title: Can AI models rebuild an animation from screenshots?
